description: Export Open Aria recordings from memory cards to side-by-side MP4 while preserving the original recording data.

script: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Open Aria Exporter NSIS uninstaller was not found in the Scoop version directory.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Open Aria Exporter uninstaller exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }

notes: Runs the official NSIS setup silently and directs the program files to the Scoop version directory. The installer requires elevation and creates an all-users Start Menu shortcut and HKLM uninstall entry.
Settings and export history remain outside Scoop under %LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenAriaExporter. Use Scoop to manage application updates.
The upstream root LICENSE reserves all rights; the installer is linked directly from the public release and is not rehosted. The applicable license is recorded as Unknown.
